title: Canonical derived base change for a module
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ and $g:T\to S$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and form $X_T=X\times_S T$ with projections $f_T:X_T\to T$ and $g_X:X_T\to X$ [def-pc-base-change]. Let $G$ be an $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], embedded in degree zero in $D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category]. The derived-to-ordinary pullback comparison $c_a:La^*(M[0])\to(a^*M)[0]$ for a morphism $a:Y\to Z$ and an $\mathcal O_Z$-module $M$ is the transpose under $La^*\dashv Ra_*$ [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-adjoint] of the ordinary tensor-pullback unit $M\to a_*a^*M$ [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction] [def-pc-module-pullback] in degree zero followed by $a_*\to Ra_*$. Equivalently, $c_a$ is the value at $M[0]$ of the counit $La^*\Rightarrow a^*$ exhibiting $La^*$ as the left derived functor of the termwise tensor pullback $a^*$ [def-pc-derived-pullback], followed by the identification $a^*(M[0])=(a^*M)[0]$; a different choice of that left-derived counit changes $c_a$ by an automorphism of $La^*(M[0])$. The canonical module base-change map $Lg^*Rf_*(G[0])\to Rf_{T,*}((g_X^*G)[0])$ is the derived base-change map [def-pc-derived-base-change-map] followed by $Rf_{T,*}(c_{g_X})$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image] [def-pc-derived-pullback].

lean.statement: def IsDerivedModuleBaseChangeMap [∀ Y : Scheme.{uMB}, HasDerivedCategory.{wMB} (SheafOfModules.{uMB} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))] {X S T : Scheme.{uMB}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : T ⟶ S) [(Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).Additive] (G : X.Modules) (φ : (derivedPullback g).obj ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (SheafOfModules.{uMB} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj G)) ⟶ (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f g)).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (SheafOfModules.{uMB} (moduleRings (pullback f g).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj G))) : Prop
